project.name: Saura Energy
project.domain: Enterprise Marketing & Lead Generation - Clean Energy
project.theme: Light Theme (with cinematic dark mode Hero)
project.archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) blended with Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) for trust and authority.
project.vibe: Trustworthy, Premium, Technologically advanced, Environment-friendly, Corporate yet approachable.

primary.name: Deep Blue
primary.usage: Wordmarks, Headings, Primary brand identity, Footers, and Dark surfaces for high contrast.

secondary.name: Solar Orange
secondary.usage: CTAs, accents, dynamic gradients, interactive elements to signify energy and action.

accent.name: Sustainability Green
accent.usage: Success states, sustainability metrics, badges, and eco-friendly accents.

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3. Corporate, bold, premium look. Ensure tracking-tight for sizes > 32px.

body.usage: Body text, labels, subtle UI elements. Highly legible and clean.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Use large paddings (p-12, p-16, p-24) to establish a premium corporate feel. Do not crowd sections.
layout_and_spacing.grids: Use 12-column bento grids for features and project showcases to avoid boring symmetric cards.

buttons.primary: bg-[#F26A21] text-white hover:bg-[#D95B1A] shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-semibold
buttons.secondary: bg-[#1B3A8C] text-white hover:bg-[#142B6A] shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-semibold
buttons.outline: border-2 border-[#1B3A8C] text-[#1B3A8C] hover:bg-[#1B3A8C] hover:text-white transition-all rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-semibold

cards.style: Modern glassmorphism. bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/40 shadow-sm rounded-2xl overflow-hidden.
cards.hover: Hover state should slightly lift (-translate-y-1) and enhance shadow to shadow-lg.

inputs.style: Shadcn standard but with rounded-xl, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#F26A21] border-slate-200.

header.classes: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200/50 shadow-sm

hero.vibe: Cinematic and Dark. A high-impact drone shot of solar panels with a heavy dark overlay to make white heading and orange CTAs pop.
hero.layout: Left-aligned text block, large H1, energetic secondary text.

trust_strip.content: Partner brands (Tata, Adani, Waaree, Luminous) and Bank logos (SBI, PNB, BOB, Canara).

services.layout: Grid-based (Bento style preferred). Interactive service cards covering 9 services.
services.visuals: Icons or subtle background images per card. Hover reveals more details.

savings_calculator.ui: Sliders for electricity bill, animated charts for 'Savings over 25 years'. Uses Shadcn slider/chart primitives.

projects.layout: Filterable grid (Residential, Commercial). Uses before/after sliders for impact.

process_timeline.content: 7 steps. SVG dashed lines connecting icons. Icons fill with #2BA84A as scrolled into view.

subsidy_finance.highlight: PM Surya Ghar scheme – ₹85,800. Use Poster 1/2 references.
subsidy_finance.layout: Split layout. Left: Information and scheme details, Right: Image/Poster with strong CTA.

footer.content: Address (Agartala, Tripura), phone numbers, social links, newsletter signup.

animation_guidelines.principles: Smooth, professional, non-distracting. Use ease-out or spring transitions. Stagger list items.
animation_guidelines.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
animation_guidelines.effects: Subtle parallax on background images. Floating energy particles in the Hero section.

dos: Use data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
Employ glassmorphism for floating UI elements to maintain a modern, clean look.
Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and Manrope for body text.
Prioritize high-contrast text to ensure accessibility.
Ensure CTA buttons use the Solar Orange (#F26A21) or Deep Blue (#1B3A8C) for clear hierarchy.
Use real imagery instead of illustrations to build trust.
donts: DO NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', or 'Open Sans' for headings.
DO NOT use a fully transparent header; always include a blur or semi-solid background.
DO NOT make the UI predominantly dark mode except for the cinematic hero section.
DO NOT use generic shadow classes everywhere; rely on 1px borders combined with soft ambient shadows.
DO NOT use placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com) for images; strictly use the provided media URLs.
